fire: Drug binding to the receptor relies on non-covalent contacts in the pocket.
These gels are held together by noncovalent crosslinks between chains.
In supramolecular chemistry, non-covalent assembly creates large structures.
The dimer is stabilized by several non-covalent contacts at its interface.
Researchers measured the strength of the noncovalent association in water.
Enzymes often recognize substrates through non-covalent binding first.
Graphene can be modified by non-covalent functionalization with pyrene.
Unlike permanent bonds, the noncovalent links break easily when heated.
